description: This file contains benchmarking code for quantized GEMM (general matrix multiplication) operations using QNNPACK, including setup for different hardware architectures, external library references, and various benchmark configurations.

classes.name: Q8GEMM
classes.description: Benchmark fixture class for quantized 8-bit GEMM operations, managing data buffers and parameters.

classes.name: GemmlowpOutputPipeline
classes.description: Helper struct for constructing output processing pipelines for gemmlowp low-precision matrix multiplication.

classes.name: Q8GEMM_L1
classes.description: Template class for cache-optimized GEMM operations with specific block sizes.

classes.name: Q8GEMM_Op
classes.description: Template class for GEMM operations with configurable matrix sizes, used in benchmarks.

classes.name: GEMMLOWP
classes.description: Benchmark fixture class for gemmlowp low-precision GEMM, conditionally included.

methods.name: divideRoundUp
methods.description: Rounds up division of x by q.

methods.name: roundUp
methods.description: Rounds up x to the nearest multiple of q.
